what.text: This page follows refugees from Georgia living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3135 Georgian refugees in Germany, 18.1% of all refugees from Georgia.
France hosts the most Georgian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Ireland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over South Ossetia territory in Georgia in 2004 and 2008.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Georgia.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 2644 refugees and fell to a low in 2013.
The figure was at its highest, 3338, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005, 2009 to 2012 and 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
